title: [Core][Observability] Add KV cache residency metrics (#27793)
reported_gain: N/A (observability feature; author claims <0.1% overhead/request at 1% sampling, not a speedup)
note: OBSERVABILITY FEATURE, not a perf optimization. Title: '[Core][Observability] Add KV cache residency metrics'. Adds 3 Prometheus histograms (kv_block_lifetime/idle_before_evict/reuse_gap) behind --kv-cache-metrics flags (default 1% sampling) via new KVCacheMetricsCollector in block_pool hot paths (on_block_allocated/accessed/evicted), each guarded by `if self.metrics_collector:` so disabled=zero cost. The '0.1%' is the author's OVERHEAD ceiling (~365ns/block @1% sampling), NOT a gain. No base-vs-gold speedup exists; correctness-only is correct. If benchmarked, it would measure feature OVERHEAD (lower-is-better, inverted), not improvement.
